
== Japanese Hoth printing ==
The collecting encyclopedia, p. 103, index 4366, confirms this Light Side, black-border, nonfoil Device publication and rarity; p. 43 dates its Japanese Limited edition to September 1998. <ref name="encyclopedia-172-hoth">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103.</ref> The English display name and printing ID <code>1303_28o</code> follow the approved identity mapping. The source index is not the printing ID. Missing data: a verified full-resolution Japanese card face; Japanese printed title, lore, game text, subtype, uniqueness, symbols and statistics; translation and wording comparison. The small product illustrations on p. 43 do not establish a complete readable transcription for the selected printing. No native-title alias, gameplay-equivalence claim or GEMP implementation claim is made. Source preservation has not yet been verified.
